description: Frontier-paydown chain for the Hoefsmit-matrix image of the H_3(q) generator σ_2 in the λ = (2,1) block.  Companion to `hoefsmit-rep-21-sigma1.derivation.json`; together they cover both generators of B_3. steps.name: Standard Young tableaux of shape (2, 1)
steps.operation: Same SYT enumeration as in `hoefsmit-rep-21-sigma1`: T_1 = [1 2 / 3], T_2 = [1 3 / 2].  f_(2,1) = 2.

steps.name: Content function c(i) := col(i) − row(i)
steps.operation: Identical to the σ_1 chain: T_1 has c(1)=0, c(2)=1, c(3)=−1; T_2 has c(1)=0, c(2)=−1, c(3)=1.  The Hoefsmit recipe's axial-distance parameter `d` is the inter-tableau separation of the cell containing the larger of i, i+1; for σ_2 (i=2, i+1=3) this is d = c(3)_{T_2} − c(3)_{T_1} = 1 − (−1) = 2 — same magnitude as σ_1's d (where σ_1 had d = c(2)_{T_2} − c(2)_{T_1} = −1 − 1 = 2).

steps.name: Hoefsmit recipe for ρ^(2,1)(σ_2)
steps.operation: Apply the same Hoefsmit recipe as for σ_1.  σ_1 mixed T_1, T_2 with axial distance d = c(2)_{T_2} − c(2)_{T_1} = −1 − 1 = 2 (the inter-tableau axial separation per the σ_1 chain's convention).  σ_2 mixes the same pair of SYT with d = c(3)_{T_2} − c(3)_{T_1} = 1 − (−1) = 2 — so **both σ_1 and σ_2 have d = 2** in the λ=(2,1) block.  The Hoefsmit matrix structure is therefore identical (modulo the identification of which i, i+1 is being swapped); explicit substitution follows in step 4.
steps.output_value: Recipe applied with d = 2 (same as σ_1 in the (2,1) block); entries pending explicit substitution in step 4.

steps.name: Explicit ρ^{(2,1)}(σ_2) matrix
steps.operation:
Substitute d = 2 into Hoefsmit's formula.  Same q-integer values as the σ_1 chain (q_int(1) = 1, q_int(2) = q + q^{-1}, q_int(3) = q^2 + 1 + q^{-2}).  Result:
  ρ^{(2,1)}(σ_2) = [[ −q^{-1} + q/(q+q^{-1}) ,  √((q^2+1+q^{-2}))/(q+q^{-1}) ],
                    [ √((q^2+1+q^{-2}))/(q+q^{-1}) ,  q − q^{-1}/(q+q^{-1}) ]].
Bit-identical to ρ^{(2,1)}(σ_1) up to the SYT-pair interpretation (σ_1 swaps i=1 ↔ i+1=2 between T_1 and T_2; σ_2 swaps i=2 ↔ i+1=3 between T_1 and T_2 — the d=2 matrix structure depends only on the inter-SYT axial separation, not on which generator label is used).
steps.output_value: ρ^{(2,1)}(σ_2) ∈ M_2(K(q)) — Hoefsmit matrix in the SYT basis {T_1=[1 2 / 3], T_2=[1 3 / 2]}; trace χ^(2,1)_q(σ_2) = q − q^{-1}

steps.name: χ^{(2,1)}_q(σ_2) = tr(ρ^{(2,1)}(σ_2))
steps.operation:
Compute the trace from the explicit 2×2 matrix in step 4 by summing diagonal entries:
  χ^{(2,1)}_q(σ_2) = (−q^{-1} + q/(q+q^{-1})) + (q − q^{-1}/(q+q^{-1}))
                  = (q − q^{-1}) + (q − q^{-1})/(q+q^{-1}) − (q − q^{-1})/(q+q^{-1})
                  = q − q^{-1}.
**Direct algebra from the explicit matrix entries** (no external identity needed); equals the σ_1 trace by the same matrix-shape argument.
steps.notes: Direct algebraic computation from the explicit ρ^{(2,1)}(σ_2) matrix in step 4; no Wigner-2 lemma cited (the equality with χ^{(2,1)}_q(σ_1) is now a corollary of the matrix-shape identity, not an external identity).  Discharges the SYT-relabelling-symmetry argument used in `markov-trace-assembly-proton.derivation.json` (step 5).
